name: Winthrop Technology
summary: UWA's Western Australian Regional Computing Centre (WARCC, 1972) renamed and spun off as Winthrop Technology ~1992; commercial computing-services company (lineage continues as Winthrop Australia). NOT related to Westnet (a separate Geraldton-founded ISP, 1994, -> iiNet 2008).

events.details: WARCC renamed Winthrop Technology and spun off from UWA.
Business name held by Alphawest (Feb-Nov 2000); lineage to Winthrop Australia.
